outcome: APGAR score < 7 at one and five minutes
finding: The prevalence of anaemia in early pregnancy was low (2.2%) and while not statistically significant, there was a trend towards a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes in women who were anaemic.
mod_finding: The study found no statistically significant effect of anemia on mode of delivery, although adverse pregnancy outcomes, including mode of delivery, were more common in those with anemia.
